scientific_integrity: The descent–Hochster decomposition and chordal clique-complex theorem are explicitly attributed to their originating sources. The proof derives the sharp induced-cycle degree and rank from those results and an exact inversion minimization. No independent audit or external certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Type-A groups and clique-indexed partial flag diagrams; does not determine higher even groups, ring structure, or homotopy type. Finite checks are not general proofs.
title: Weighted chordless cycles detect the first even homology of type-A parabolic homotopy colimits
